title: Goa rabies‑free state
subject: Geography
caption: Map of India highlighting Goa as the first rabies‑free state.
altText: A white‑background map of India with thin gray outlines for each state. Goa is filled with bright green and labeled "Goa – Rabies‑free (first state)". All other states are light gray with black labels. A legend in the lower right shows a green square for rabies‑free and a gray square for not rabies‑free. The top title reads "Goa: First Rabies‑Free State in India". The illustration is high‑resolution, accurately proportioned, and clearly labelled for educational use.
